senses.gloss:
पुल् पुल् [cf. rt. पॄ], cl. 1. 6. 10. P.
पोलति, पुलति, पोलयति, &c., to be
great or large; to be lofty or high; to be piled or
heaped up.

पूल् पूल्, cl. 1. 10. P. पूलति, पूलयति,
यितुम्, to collect, gather, heap up, accu-
mulate.
पुल्ल पुल्ल wrongly for फुल्ल, q. v.

पूल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), or पूलक, अस्, m.
a bundle, pack.

पुलक, अस्, m. erection or bristling of the hairs
of the body (considered by the Hindūs to be
occasioned by delight or desire rather than by fear),
a thrill of joy or of fear, horripilation; a species of
edible plant; a kind of stone or gem; flaw or defect
in a gem; any kind of insect or vermin infesting
animals; a ball of bread and sweetmeats with which
elephants are fed; yellow orpiment; a Gandharva or
heavenly chorister; a wine-goblet or glass; a species
of mustard; (अम्), n. a species of earth (= कङ्कु-
ष्ठ).
—पुलकाकुलाकृति (˚क-आक्˚, ˚ल-आक्˚), इस्,
इस्, इ, ‘having the frame excited by horripilation,’
thrilled with joy.
—पुलकाङ्ग (˚क-अङ्˚), अस्, m.
the noose or cord of Varuṇa.
—पुलकालय (˚क-
आल्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera.
—पुलकी-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs or down of the body
erect, thrilled with delight.
—पुलकीकृताङ्ग (˚त-
अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, whose body has its hairs erect,
having the body thrilled with joy.
—पुलकोद्गम
[]
(˚क-उद्˚), अस्, m. erection of the hairs of the body
(through rapture), horripilation.

पुलाक, अस्, अम्, m. n. shrivelled or blighted or
empty grain, bad grain; a small lump of rice rolled
into a ball, a lump of boiled rice; (according to par-
ticular medical authorities) rice-water; brevity, abbre-
viation, abridgement, compendium; smallness, a
little; celerity, dispatch.
—पुलाक-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
making haste, hastening.
पुल्लक पुल्लक, अम् (?), n. = आश्चर्य, wonder.

पुलकय, Nom. P. पुलकयति, -यितुम्, to have
or feel the hairs of the body erect (with rapture or
desire).

पुलकित, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs or down
of the body erect or bristling up with joy, thrilled
with joy, delighted, rejoiced, enraptured, joyful.

पुलकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having the hairs or down of
the body erect, thrilled, enraptured; (ई), m. a species
of Kadamba tree (= धारा-कदम्ब).
पुलाकिन्, ई, m. a tree.

पुलस्ति, इस्, इस्, इ (perhaps fr. पुलस् for पुरस्,
cf. पलस्ति fr. परस्, but said to be fr. पुल and rt.
3. अस्), wearing the hair straight or plain; (gender
doubtful), the hair of the head; (इस्), m., N. of a
man.

पुलस्त्य, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पुल्; per-
haps fr. पुलस् for पुरस्), N. of an ancient
Ṛṣi, one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā (Manu
1. 35; also enumerated among the Prajā-patis and
seven sages, and described as a lawgiver); an epithet
of Śiva.
—पुलस्त्य-स्मृति, इस्, f., N. of a work
mentioned in the Śūdra-dharma-tattva.

पुलह, अस्, m., N. of an ancient Ṛṣi, one of
the mind-born sons of Brahmā enumerated among
the Prajā-patis and the seven sages (Manu I. 35);
an epithet of Śiva.
पुलानिका, f. (perhaps) induration of the skin.

पुलायित, अम्, n. a horse's gallop; (a wrong
reading for पलायित.)

पुलिन, अस्, अम्, m. n. a sandbank, land deposited
by alluvium on the bank of a river; an island of
alluvial formation or one from which the water has
recently withdrawn, a small island or bank left in
the middle of a river by the subsiding of its waters,
an islet; a sandy beach; (according to a Scholiast)
= तीर, the bank of a river; (अस्), m., N. of a
mythical being conquered by Garuḍa.
—पुलिन-
जघना, f. having sandbanks for hips (said of the
Gambhīrā river personified as a female).
—पुलिन-
द्वीप-शोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with shoals and
islands.
—पुलिन-प्रदेश, अस्, m. island-site, situa-
tion on an island.
—पुलिन-मण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्,
adorned with sandbanks or islets.
—पुलिन-वती, f.
‘possessing sandbanks,’ (probably) N. of a river.

पुलिक पुलिक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ), f.
yellowish alum.

पूलिका पूलिका, f. a kind of pastry; [cf.
पूरिका, पोलिका, पौलि.]
पुलिमत् पुलिमत्, आन्, m., N. of a man.
पुलिरिक पुलिरिक, अस्, m. a snake.

पुलिश पुलिश, अस्, m. = Paulus (Alexan-
drinus), N. of the author of a Siddhānta.

पुलु पुलु = पुरु (in particular comps.).
—पुलु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having many de-
sires, covetous (Sāy.) = बहुकामना-वत्.
—पुल्व्-
अघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. doing much evil.
पुलुष पुलुष, अस्, m., N. of a man.

पुलोम पुलोम, अस्, m. = पुलोमन्, q. v.;
(आ), f., N. of a daughter of the demon Vaiśvānara,
(she was loved by the demon Puloman, but became
the wife of Bhṛgu or Kaśyapa); the plant Acorus
Calamus (= वचा).

पुलोमन्, आ, m., N. of a demon (the father-in-law
[]
of Indra by whom he was destroyed).
—पुलोम-जा,
f. ‘daughter of Puloman,’ an epithet of the wife of
Indra.
—पुलोम-जित्, त्, or पुलोम-भिद्, त्, m.
‘conquerer or destroyer of Puloman,’ an epithet of
Indra (who destroyed his father-in-law Puloman in
order to avert his imprecation consequent on the
violation of his daughter).
—पुलोम-द्विष्, ट्, or
पुलोमारि (˚म-अरि), इस्, m. ‘foe of Puloman,’ an
epithet of Indra.
—पुलोमार्चिस् (˚म-अर्˚), इस्, m.
‘having the lustre of Puloman,’ N. of a prince.

पुलोमत् पुलोमत्, आन्, m., N. of a prince;
[cf. पुलिमत्.]
पुलोमही पुलोमही, f. opium.

पुल्कस पुल्कस, अस्, m., Ved. (according
to the commentators) = पौल्कस.

पूल्य पूल्य, अम्, n. an empty or shrivelled
grain of corn.
